name: switch-form
title: Switch form
description: A settings card of switches bound to a Signal Forms model.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { disabled, form, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals'; import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet, } from '@/ui/form-field/form-field'; import { Switch, SwitchThumb } from '@/ui/switch/switch'; /** * Email settings as switches bound to a Signal Forms model, each saved as * soon as it changes; security emails can't be turned off. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-switch-form', imports: [ Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet, FormField, Switch, SwitchThumb, ], template: `
Email notifications

Receive emails about new products, features and more.

Receive emails about your account security.

`, }) export class SwitchFormExample { protected readonly model = signal({ marketing: false, security: true }); protected readonly settings = form(this.model, (path) => { disabled(path.security); }); }
